sections.title: Reporting Unverified Information
sections.content: *Állítólag* indicates that the speaker is reporting hearsay without personal verification: *Állítólag holnap esni fog az eső.* ('Supposedly it will rain tomorrow.'). You know *állítólag* and *szerint* from Unit 25; here they are used for rumours and sources. It is close to English *allegedly*.

items.spanish: Állítólag új szabályokat vezetnek be a cégnél a jövő hónaptól.
items.english: Supposedly they are introducing new rules at the company from next month.

items.spanish: A hírek szerint a forrás nem volt teljesen megbízható.
items.english: According to the news, the source was not entirely reliable.
